semanticReview.method: Follow-up source-to-claim review separating morphology, lexical sense, construction meaning, passive/causative, result state, register and examples.
findings: La ficha distingue el sustantivo dependiente 것 de la palabra léxica “cosa”, y analiza formas modificadoras 먹는 것/예쁜 것/학생인 것.

La respuesta oficial NIKL para V-는 것 (revisada en el lote previo) respalda parcialmente que -는 modifica el sustantivo dependiente 것 y que la expresión es nominal; no cubre adjetivos, cópula ni 모든 partículas.
Los ejemplos 책을 읽는 것이, 예쁜 것을 y 의사인 것을 necesitan localizadores exactos; los matices de traducción no se demuestran con la definición general.
먹는 것/예쁜 것/학생인 것 involve different predicate types; no single official source for this full paradigm was located.
limitations: La fuente localizada cubre solo una subclase; falta gramática primaria para modificadores descriptivos/copulares, partículas y la diferencia entre significado léxico y función gramatical.
No directly adequate open primary source was located for the exact construction/examples or claimed register; further source checking is required.

followupResearch.method: Follow-up against public NIKL dictionary entries, official answers and Sejong teaching material; only exact scoped locators were credited.
followupResearch.result: Partial source support only; unresolved claims and examples remain pending.
